verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing says it can "reduce manual workload by automating recurring fixes" and lists remote script execution alongside custom monitoring policies. That implies some recurring automation, but nothing documents a scheduler, cron-style recurrence, or workflow definitions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling recurring jobs or workflows (time-based triggers, recurrence configuration), API or programmatic access to schedules, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
